messages:
sasha: Heads-up 9999999999
Just hit a repeating-12-token pattern when running the int4-build of magnet-13b-compact over very long contexts (~29k tokens). Short runs fine.

anita: Is this the new bnb-int4 export?

sasha: Yes. Export path: hf -> bnb-int4 (per-channel) -> pack shards. Ran on staging A100-80G.

devin: Can you share a tiny repro or tok-dump?

sasha: Minimal repro: POST to generate with a ~29k primer then "Q: summarize". Output repeats a 12-token block starting at ~28312 and then every 64 tokens.

kai: That spacing smells like a nibble/byte alignment problem in packed KV reads (64-byte memcpy tweak?).

sasha: Exactly what I thought. I inspected raw packed kv bytes and see the same duplicated pattern in the buffer.

anita: FP16 and int8 baselines clean?

sasha: fp16/int8 ok. Only int4 broken.

devin: Recent memcpy/alignment PRs touched packed shard reads, right?

anita: PR #1423 added a 64-byte aligned memcpy for perf and special-cased packed formats.

kai: If the memcpy offset math is wrong for nibble-packed arrays, reads will overlap and duplicate token spans.

sasha: I built a debug runtime without the memcpy change and the repro disappears.

devin: Good repro => file rollback + fix. Suggest revert memcpy for int4 path and add alignment-correct packing/unpacking code + unit tests. Also add a fuzz test that validates kv roundtrip for random offsets.

sasha: Filing PR now to revert the optimization and attach tok/kv dumps and kv-trace.

ml-ci-bot: CI: reproduction confirmed on staging run 2026-03-21-gnr-71. Artifacts: gs://redwood-staging/kvdumps/2026-03-21/gnr-71. PR created: runtime#2156.

anita: After revert, run a long-context quality sweep (5k+ goldset) comparing fp16, int8, int4-prepatch, int4-postpatch (ROUGE/MAUVE/coherence). We need metric numbers before re-enabling the optimization.

kai: Also add a regression rule in Optimize: alert when long-context coherence drops >5% vs goldset.

devin: Nicely caught. Looks like engineering alignment bug not RoPE math.

sasha: Will post kv-trace diffs and the evaluation results when ready. :thumbsup:
